results_number_check.name: results_number_check
results_number_check.detail: "results"."metric_type" <> 'number' OR ("results"."start_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."target_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."cadence" IS NULL AND "results"."per" IS NULL AND "results"."since" IS NULL)

results_percentage_check.name: results_percentage_check
results_percentage_check.detail: "results"."metric_type" <> 'percentage' OR ("results"."start_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."target_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."start_value" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "results"."target_value" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "results"."cadence" IS NULL AND "results"."per" IS NULL AND "results"."since" IS NULL AND "results"."unit" IS NULL)

results_milestone_check.name: results_milestone_check
results_milestone_check.detail: "results"."metric_type" <> 'milestone' OR ("results"."start_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."start_value" = 0 AND "results"."target_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."target_value" = 1 AND "results"."cadence" IS NULL AND "results"."per" IS NULL AND "results"."since" IS NULL AND "results"."unit" IS NULL)

results_habit_check.name: results_habit_check
results_habit_check.detail: "results"."metric_type" <> 'habit' OR ("results"."cadence" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."per" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."per" >= 1 AND "results"."since" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."start_value" IS NULL AND "results"."target_value" IS NULL AND "results"."unit" IS NULL)

results_performance_check.name: results_performance_check
results_performance_check.detail: "results"."metric_type" <> 'performance' OR ("results"."target_value" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."since" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."cadence" IS NULL AND "results"."per" IS NULL)

results_finite_values_check.name: results_finite_values_check
results_finite_values_check.detail: ("results"."start_value" IS NULL OR "results"."start_value" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("results"."target_value" IS NULL OR "results"."target_value" NOT IN ('NaN'::numeric, 'Infinity'::numeric, '-Infinity'::numeric))
